decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that fully records the reusable-background and translatable-text strategy, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The tutorial-image strategy was already established by the client in message 46; message 49 confirms that existing strategy without changing the candidate's state.
Rendering translatable text over reusable tutorial backgrounds is an asset and size strategy; it does not change the current scope or obligation to localize the full iOS app.
The reusable tutorial-background decision does not change the requirement for correct right-to-left layout behavior.
The localized-image strategy does not alter iOS framework modernization, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The tutorial asset strategy has no effect on the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
Using translatable text in tutorial screens is compatible with the existing full-app localization requirement but does not change its current value or scope.
The localized tutorial asset decision does not affect iOS signing certificates or signing configuration.
The reusable-background strategy does not change Android platform compatibility, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The tutorial asset strategy has no effect on removal of the unused READ_PHONE_STATE permission or the broader Android permission policy.
